# Asset Interest

Captures expressions of interest about an asset, collection, or product from any perspective — owner wishlists, beneficiary preferences, executor observations, proxy-relayed interests, and cross-system collector interest. Qualified by expressedByRole (who), intentType (what kind), and optionally productMatch (product-level vs asset-level). Maps to Schema.org ReactAction + Role

Source: [`v3/asset-interest.json`](../../v3/asset-interest.json)

Schema `$id`: `https://openinherit.org/v3/asset-interest.json`

## Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` (uuid) | yes | Unique identifier for this interest record |
| `rootDocumentId` | `string` (uuid) | yes | The root document this entity belongs to — either an estate document (schema.json) or a catalogue document (catalogue.json) |
| `assetId` | `string` or `null` (uuid) | | Reference to a specific Asset.id, if the interest is in a single asset |
| `collectionId` | `string` or `null` (uuid) | | Reference to an AssetCollection.id, if the interest is in an entire collection |
| `personId` | `string` (uuid) | | The person expressing interest (a Person.id). The person's relationship to the estate is qualified by expressedByRole |
| `personIdDisplay` | `string` | | Human-readable display name for the referenced person |
| `interestLevel` | one of `mentioned`, `expressed_interest`, `strongly_wants`, `agreed` | yes | How strongly the beneficiary has expressed interest |
| `sourceType` | one of `family_conversation`, `written_request`, `chat_message`, `platform_private_message`, `platform_group_message`, `proxy_reported`, `testator_observed`, `manual` | | How this interest was communicated or recorded |
| `interestStatus` | one of `submitted`, `acknowledged`, `responded`, `withdrawn`, `superseded` | | Where this expression of interest has got to. Modelled on dealer-interest offerStatus, without the stages of a priced offer. An expression of interest binds no one at any stage; the testator's answer is testatorDisposition |
| `testatorDisposition` | one of `noted`, `tentatively_earmarked`, `declined` | when `interestStatus` is `responded` | The testator's response to this expression of interest. Modelled on dealer-interest testatorDisposition. Never a gift and never a disposition: only a will or a bequest disposes. A direction about how the item should be distributed is a wish, not a response |
| `communicationInitiatedBy` | one of `interested_party`, `testator`, `proxy`, `executor` | | Who raised this interest. Modelled on dealer-interest communicationInitiatedBy. An interest the testator invited is evidence of the testator's own initiative, and one the person raised unprompted is the case an undue-influence review looks at, so the two are recorded rather than inferred. Distinct from sourceType, which is the channel |
| `visibility` | [Visibility](common/visibility.md) | | Who may see this interest record. An heir's request can be sensitive among siblings, and the testator may want it private |
| `images` | array of [Media](common/media.md) | | Photographs, videos, voice notes or document scans supporting this expression of interest — for example the person explaining why the item matters to them. Use mediaType for the format |
| `notes` | `string` | | Additional context about this interest |
| `organisationId` | `string` (uuid) | | Reference to the Organisation.id expressing interest, if an organisation rather than a person. Mutually exclusive with personId |
| `organisationIdDisplay` | `string` | | Human-readable display name for the referenced organisation |
| `expressedByRole` | one of `testator`, `beneficiary`, `executor`, `proxy` or `string` | | The role of the person expressing this interest in relation to the estate or catalogue. Qualifies the authority and weight of the expression. Follows the Schema.org Role pattern |
| `intentType` | one of `acquire`, `receive`, `allocate`, `sell`, `admire` or `string` | | The nature of the interest being expressed. Distinguishes between wanting to acquire, wanting to receive, wanting to allocate to someone, willingness to sell, and soft admiration |
| `productMatch` | `object` | | Interest in any asset matching this product identity, rather than a specific asset. Use instead of assetId when the interest is in a product class, not a specific instance. Maps to Schema.org Product (vs IndividualProduct for assetId). Matching is by identifier (strongest), brand + category (medium), or category alone (weakest) |
| `quantity` | `integer` | | Number of items desired (for productMatch wishlist entries) or number of the specific asset being discussed. Default 1 if absent. Follows the same convention as asset.quantity |
| `expressedAt` | `string` (date-time) | | When this interest was expressed or recorded |
| `preOrderStatus` | `object` | | For wishlist items that have been pre-ordered from a dealer or manufacturer but not yet received. Tracks order status, payment, and expected delivery |
| `provenance` | [Provenance](common/provenance.md) | | Consolidated provenance metadata — how this entity was created, by whom, and whether a human has verified it |

Also accepts properties whose names match `^x-inherit-[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,54}$`.
